explanation: Twenty-three people make 253 different pairs, and every pair is a chance for a match. The exact chance is about 50.7%, and with 70 people it rises above 99.9%.

claims.text: In a group of 23 people, the chance that at least two share a birthday is about 50%.
The chance is far more than 6% or 25% and well under 90%.
Assuming 365 equally likely birthdays, the probability for 23 people is about 50.7%.
With 70 people, the probability that two share a birthday is above 99.9%.
